# APK Sentinel

> Deterministic, automation-friendly static APK triage for software agents, automated security workflows, and human analysts.

## Availability

Limited beta. The documented endpoint is callable for bounded testing through x402 on Base Sepolia. This is API access, not a browser upload portal. General customer intake and support are not enabled.

Canonical status: https://github.com/tmtz1/apk-sentinel/blob/main/product-status.json
Endpoint: https://api.willowbirdie.com/v1/apk/triage

## Product

APK Sentinel accepts one Android APK and produces a structured triage report for security, fraud, app-review, trust-and-safety, and platform workflows.

## Report contents

- SHA-256 artifact identity
- Package and SDK metadata
- Permissions and dangerous-permission combinations
- Declared and exported components
- Signing schemes and certificate metadata
- Bounded URL and domain evidence
- Suspicious static API indicators
- Evidence-backed findings
- Deterministic rule-based risk score

## Safety boundary

- Static analysis only; APKs are not installed, executed, or side-loaded.
- Extracted URLs are inert report data and are not fetched.
- Resource, time, output, and concurrency limits are explicit.
- Temporary artifacts are intended to be deleted after processing.
- The report is triage evidence, not a guarantee that an APK is safe or malicious.

## Availability

Deployment, payment, pricing, and intake availability are deployment-specific and must not be inferred from this showcase repository.
